python - <<'PY'
import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')
stage10 = root / 'experiments/stage10'
state = json.loads((stage10 / '00_freeze/STAGE10_STATE.json').read_text())
meta = json.loads((stage10 / '08_meta/STAGE10_META_ANALYSIS.json').read_text())
selectors = list(csv.DictReader((stage10 / '08_meta/SELECTOR_METRICS.csv').open(newline='')))
twe = list(csv.DictReader((stage10 / '07_large_eval/TOKEN_WEIGHTED_EVAL.csv').open(newline='')))
eligible = [r for r in selectors if r['selector_name'] not in {'OrbitRepair-Proxy','CFC-only'}]
summary = {
  'meta_gate_verdict': meta['gate_results']['gate_verdict'],
  'closed_reasons': meta['gate_results']['closed_reasons'],
  'meta_model_family_gate_met': meta['gate_results']['model_family_gate_met'],
  'resource_gated_model_ids': meta['model_availability']['resource_gated_model_ids'],
  'state_coverage_model_family_gate_met': state['coverage']['model_family_gate_met'],
  'state_top_level_model_family_gate_met': state.get('model_family_gate_met'),
  'state_active_entry_count': state['active_entry_count'],
  'state_active_family_count': state['active_family_count'],
  'eligible_selector_summary': [
    {
      'selector_name': r['selector_name'],
      'delta_macro_normalized_regret_at3_vs_cfc_only': float(r['delta_macro_normalized_regret_at3_vs_cfc_only']),
      'delta_mean_cost_to_contain_winner_vs_cfc_only': float(r['delta_mean_cost_to_contain_winner_vs_cfc_only']),
      'beats_regret': r['beats_cfc_only_on_macro_normalized_regret_at3'],
      'beats_cost': r['beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner'],
    }
    for r in eligible
  ],
  'orbitrepair_proxy': next({
      'selector_name': r['selector_name'],
      'delta_macro_normalized_regret_at3_vs_cfc_only': float(r['delta_macro_normalized_regret_at3_vs_cfc_only']),
      'delta_mean_cost_to_contain_winner_vs_cfc_only': float(r['delta_mean_cost_to_contain_winner_vs_cfc_only']),
      'beats_regret': r['beats_cfc_only_on_macro_normalized_regret_at3'],
      'beats_cost': r['beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner'],
    } for r in selectors if r['selector_name']=='OrbitRepair-Proxy'),
  'token_weighted_total_rows': len(twe),
  'token_weighted_target_rows': sum(1 for r in twe if r['source_endpoint_type']=='Y_recover'),
  'negative_recovered_fraction_rows': sum(1 for r in twe if r['source_endpoint_type']=='Y_recover' and r['recovered_fraction'] and float(r['recovered_fraction']) < 0),
  'min_negative_recovered_fraction': min(float(r['recovered_fraction']) for r in twe if r['source_endpoint_type']=='Y_recover' and r['recovered_fraction'] and float(r['recovered_fraction']) < 0),
  'plot_artifact_count_png_pdf_svg_under_stage10': sum(1 for p in stage10.rglob('*') if p.suffix.lower() in {'.png','.pdf','.svg'}),
}
print(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True))
PY
